findings.text: Full independent adversarial review at 3824944 returned pass_with_notes, 0 blocking. It confirmed the harness genuinely composes the shipped pieces (call-count probe) and that the two critical guarantees hold under mutation - it could NOT make the conformance rubber-stamp a broken mapping (RJ1) nor slip a repository write-back past it (RJ2, both spec-index and plan-index write-backs caught by name). It raised NOTE 1 (the AC5 capability-honesty assertion was a loose substring check that did not bind name to status, so a live adapter mislabeled mechanical would still pass - a test-strength gap, the declarations themselves being honest), NOTE 2 (the offline shipped-status check is self-referential, correct by design per C5, worth documenting), and two minor notes (an unreachable defensive branch; a subset-guard that fires only for a rogue adapter).

NOTE 1 and NOTE 2 were addressed in this commit (f753c72): the AC5 assertion now binds each capability name to its status via a per-line regex (and adds tracker_conformance:mechanical), and the offline-conformance boundary is documented in the spec Notes. A scoped independent re-review bound to f753c72 returned PASS with zero blocking: the delta is exactly those two fixes with .warp/tracker_conformance.py BYTE-UNCHANGED (blob identical on both commits, so RJ1/RJ2 carry over intact and were re-confirmed independently), the NOTE 1 fix has real teeth (honest declarations match, dishonest flips fail, the old approach would have rubber-stamped the flip), the gate is GREEN (selftest 1205 passed, 0 failed) with no regression across WARP-0601..0608, and the two capabilities.yaml copies are byte-identical. The two minor notes were left as-is (a defensive branch and a correct subset-guard, not defects).

Operational: built in-session by a single writer; W8 is the plan's release gate (require_all_work_shipped + require_full_regression), and it provides the RJ1/RJ2 regression suite. No template twin. Verified GREEN in a clean detached worktree before and after the fix.

summary: W8 of PLAN-0006 (tracker conformance) is correct. Two independent adversarial reviews (a full pass on 3824944, a scoped re-review bound to this shipped commit f753c72) both PASS with 0 blocking. conformance_findings composes the shipped pieces (routing, seam, intake, spec mirror, epic mirror) into one end-to-end journey over the FakeTracker offline and returns named findings; it owns RJ1 (a broken mapping fails by name, no rubber-stamp - the reviewer could not fool it) and RJ2 (the tracker mutates only itself and never the repository - a write-back is caught by name, the indices deep-copied for a real guard). Idempotency holds end to end. It adds no new machinery (C3, proven by a call-count probe). A test-strength gap in the capability-honesty assertion found by review was fixed to bind each name to its status, and the offline-conformance boundary was documented. Gate GREEN (selftest 1205 passed, 0 failed), no regression, no protected path. proof_digest via validate.py.
